rules: Only Robinhood Crypto API-confirmed fills and exits may populate this ledger.

This ledger is the required evidence source for scripts/robinhood_crypto_autopilot.py's live-evidence gate, which reads docs/data/probability-first-policy.json's crypto.liveEvidenceMinimumResolvedTrades / liveEvidenceMinimumAverageR / liveEvidenceMinimumWinRatePct.
A crypto buy may execute only once resolvedTrades, averageRealizedR, and winRatePct here meet those thresholds. Zero or unknown evidence is never a pass.
Never invent missing fills, prices, quantities, order ids, slippage, or exit reasons.
